title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That does it for our Christmas show performances. Well done, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! With fun-filled performances each day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ And we got to give everyone that came to see us great, big smiles as a present too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I'd like to go home and relax after scrambling around these past few weeks for this show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Eating cake while playing video games... Priceless...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
It feels like we're forgetting something, you know? Something really important...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something we're supposed to do once Christmas is over...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Homework?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Guh... You're not wrong, but that's not it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hm? A notification on my phone? Is that person casting another game already...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(A trailer for an event...?
<Kagamine Rin and Kagamine Len's Anniversary Show Stream>...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wah?! Wh-What is it?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This! Look!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Merry Christmas, everyone♪
It's Kagamine Rin and...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Kagamine Len!
Are you guys all having a fun Christmas?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. We even got to see KAITO... I mean, Santa Claus this year!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <He visited us a little early, but he gave us a whole bunch of snacks♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That was really nice of him! But I really wish Santa Claus visited more people instead of just kids.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I know how you feel! He should visit everyone who really tried their best this past year.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Which is why... We're gonna give all of you guys some presents!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. Can you guess what?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The answer is... A special anniversary show put on by the both of us! There's even gonna be a livestream of it!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You'll get to join in on the fun even if you can't make it to the actual show!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. Miku and the others are gonna be there to celebrate too, so let's all have some fun together♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, also! Our show's gonna be divided into two parts: my part and Len's part.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They're gonna be totally different from each other, so stay tuned and be sure to check them both out!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, they're streaming their anniversary show! I'm totally gonna watch!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think I will too. They've both been great friends to us, so we should celebrate by also posting comments!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're both right...!
But that's not what I was trying to say!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. We had to temporarily suspend preparing for Rin and Len's anniversary show to work on our Christmas show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was nearly done but not quite from what I remember.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that! Thank you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: You're right!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just assumed we were done and completely forgot about it. There's still work left to do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The party venue was all set, but we were still busy discussing the finer details, no...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We wanted to sing lots and lots of songs, and were still picking out what to actually sing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! We don't have time to gloat and feel proud of our Christmas show right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My plan was to just go home and relax...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We should probably get right to it before we lose our focus.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree! Let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, help me with the layout.
I believe you wanted to use that device again from when you filled in as an extra and director.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to redecorate it using Rin and Len's colors, while also adjusting it so that it can shoot out snacks and candy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And while they do that, Nene, let's pick out some songs to sing♪ Oh, I wanna sing all of them to celebrate☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
All of them?
If we do that, we won't have any time for cake or snacks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rin and Len's anniversary...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Until just recently, I never would've seen myself celebrating VIRTUAL SINGER anniversaries like this.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Aww, Nene!
What's with the long face?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<This is a great chance to make new friends, isn't it?
Bring your smiley face and have some fun☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Nene! Are you sure you want to end the day like this?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's so sad to just say goodbye like this!
Why not arrange to meet again?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You'll be fine♪
And I'll be there to help you too☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They gave me a great celebration, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make their celebration a good one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪
